verdict.rationale: Phoenix provides official Python and client SDKs (modular install, tracing decorators, auto-instrumentation, prompts-in-code sync) plus OpenTelemetry/OpenInference-based instrumentation, giving AI-native developers first-class SDK access for tracing, evals, and prompt management; an MCP endpoint also enables agent-native integration. No OpenAPI spec was found, but SDK-based building is clearly documented and central to the product.
